# growthbook_environment (Resource)

Manages a GrowthBook environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "growthbook_environment" "staging" {
  id             = "staging"
  description    = "Staging"
  toggle_on_list = true
  default_state  = false
  projects       = ["prj_marketing"]
}

# An environment cloned from an existing one at creation time. "parent" is
# create-only: changing it forces a new resource.
resource "growthbook_environment" "staging_eu" {
  id     = "staging-eu"
  parent = growthbook_environment.staging.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Caller-chosen environment id, for example `production`. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `default_state` (Boolean) Default enabled state for new features in this environment.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the environment.
- `parent` (String) Id of the parent environment to clone rules from at creation time. Create-only: changing this forces a new resource.
- `projects` (Set of String) Project ids this environment is scoped to. Omit or leave empty for all projects.
- `toggle_on_list` (Boolean) Whether this environment appears in the feature list toggle.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import growthbook_environment.staging staging
```
